title: Dedicated: improve autoscaling burst controls and utilization reporting
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Motivation: reduce burst-driven overprovisioning on Dedicated fleets while giving operators better visibility into sustained utilization. This PR updates the autoscaler to introduce explicit burst tokens, a sliding-window sustained-utilization estimator, and richer reporting hooks for the Console and metrics pipeline. High level: 1) Add configurable burst budget that caps how many extra VMs/GPU slots a fleet can spawn for short periods; the budget refills over time based on policy. 2) Replace latent heuristics with a sliding-window estimator (default 5m window) for sustained utilization to avoid oscillation between scale-up/scale-down. 3) Emit per-fleet utilization and burst_spend metrics with tags for model_family and region, and add a lightweight /fleet/:id/utilization endpoint for tooling. 4) Backwards-compatible config: legacy autoscaling settings continue to work, new features are gated behind feature flags. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (ENG-1245) - [x] implementation in autoscaler core - [x] unit and integration tests for estimator and budget logic - [x] metrics and Console dashboard updates - [x] e2e smoke test against dedicated cluster - [x] docs and migration notes Breaking changes: none; default behavior unchanged until feature flag enabled. See release_notes for operator-visible changes and recommended configuration. Commits summarize: see commits field. CI: initial CI run failed due to flaky integration test (autoscaler_sustained_estimator_test) which was fixed by increasing test determinism and the suite passed on rerun. Rollout: feature flag rollout planned to 10% of Dedicated fleets for canary, then 100% after metric validation and 1-week observation window.

review_comments: Lena: Please add a migration note for customers pinning legacy autoscaler params. Also call out the default refill rate and why we chose it.
Marco: Can you explain how burst budget interacts with reserved capacity? Concern about double-counting when fleets have pre-committed GPUs.
Anya: Metrics look good. Suggest adding model_family tag to util metrics to help per-model cost analysis.

Priya (author): Addressed Lena and Anya comments, added migration doc and model_family tag. For Marco: clarified in docs and added unit test covering reserved capacity accounting to ensure burst is only applied to non-reserved headroom.
Marco: Thanks, tests and docs look sufficient. Approving.
release_notes: Operators can opt in to a new autoscale v2 which adds a burst budget and a sliding-window sustained utilization estimator. New metrics: fleet.utilization_pct, fleet.burst_spend. Console: Utilization widget and example dashboard added. Default autoscaling behavior unchanged until feature flag is enabled. Recommended config: burst_budget: 2000 tokens/min per GPU equivalent, refill_rate: 5% per minute, sustained_window: 5m.
